tasks.title: Finish a document
tasks.blurb: Check a document for leftover text, errors and spelling, then write its PDF.
steps: Tick PDF/A if your submission needs the archival format.
Problems are listed with line numbers; fix them and run again.

tasks.title: Write slides from notes
tasks.blurb: Write the slides of a presentation from a notes file with a local LM Studio model.
steps: Pick the presentation's folder (made with newdoc).
Pick your notes file, or leave it empty to use slides.txt in the folder.

tasks.title: Rebuild slides
tasks.blurb: Rebuild the slides from slides.json after editing it, without the LLM.
steps: It is rebuilt from the folder's slides.json.
